rows.en: They're my family.
rows.notes: Family photo referent supplies plural subject; no identities revealed prematurely.

rows.en: But if I remember right... the old Nadesico's captain...
rows.notes: Eris recalls the photograph; unfinished recollection retained.

rows.en: Are they your big brother and sister, by any chance?
Not quite... but you're mostly right.
Huh...
...I've seen them on the news... The Nadesico's former captain, Yurika Misumaru, and former crew member, Akito Tenkawa...
rows.notes: Thought identifies the photographed pair; full sourced names retained.

rows.en: I think they said the two died in a shuttle accident on their honeymoon...
Is there anything else?
N-no... um... well... If you wouldn't mind, I'd really like to learn about the Nadesico, for future reference...
rows.notes: Hesitant request trails off as in source.

rows.en: Of course. Ask Harry anything you like, as long as it isn't classified.
Harry...?
I'm Ensign Hari Makibi, assistant to the Nadesico B's first officer. Please call me Harry.
rows.notes: Prefilled speaker Hari retained; glossary nickname Harry used in body.

rows.en: Good for you, Harry. You've made a cute friend your own age.
P-please don't tease me!
Don't be shy. Maybe you're headed straight... for... a rosy romance!
rows.notes: Spaced emphasis reproduced with spoken pauses. Meaning correction: restored the rosy-romance image, absent from initial draft; source emphasis kept.

rows.en: W-what are you talking about?!
It's fine, it's fine. Oh, I'm Saburota Takasugi. Nice to meet you.
...I'm Rain Mikamura. I'm sorry for all the trouble I caused during the Devil Gundam incident a year ago.
So you're the one from back then? That means the King of Hearts is here too...
rows.notes: Recognition leads into unfinished reference to Domon.

rows.en: ...Yeah. I've wanted to meet this ship's crew and thank you all in person.
Oh, right! That was you! I heard that cry from the depths of your soul.
Urk...
A cry from his soul? What's that about?
W-well, um...
Right before he finished off the Devil Gundam, he shouted so loud you could hear it all across space...
rows.notes: Lead-in to quoted confession at 424 retained.

rows.en: He went, "I looove you! I waaant you!"
Th-that was...
rows.notes: Embarrassed unfinished explanation retained.

rows.en: Wow... Domon, you really said that to Rain?
Uh... w-well, yeah.
D-Domon... You're a man among men...
A confession that passionate would send shivers down anyone's spine. Seriously.
I'm so jealous...
rows.notes: Female lead envies the passionate confession.

rows.en: Huh?
Oh... no, I mean...
Don't worry, don't worry. With looks as gorgeous as yours, someone will say that to you someday.
H-here it comes... the usual wisecrack. I'll put up with it until the fifth time. Until the fifth time.
rows.notes: Female lead expects the usual teasing; fifth-time refrain retained.
uncertain: The usual wisecrack is interpreted as Aqua expecting a familiar jab; no accusation or added outfit detail inserted.

rows.en: Or should I say it to you myself?
Cap-tain Ta-ka-su-gi...?
rows.notes: Drawn-out syllabic admonition retained.

rows.en: Oh? Or would you like to say it to her?
W-w-w-w-what are you talking about?!
You know, you really ought to add a little more variety to your reactions.
I'm not an Aestivalis!
rows.notes: Reply jokes about interchangeable Aestivalis configurations.

rows.en: Speaking of Aestivalises... I hear a unit resembling one appeared in Kyoto?
Yes... it used a Boson Jump.
rows.notes: Restored unit subject and action from 441.

rows.en: Could you give me the detailed data?
Yes. We have video recordings too.
Captain, could it be that...?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished reference, clarified by 446.

rows.en: You mean the ghost robot from the "Aoi Report"?
rows.notes: Aoi Report is literal pending centralized terminology sourcing. Root sourced Japanese title at https://www.kinokuniya.co.jp/f/dsg-01-9784048530446; English label remains provisional.
uncertain: Aoi Report Japanese title is confirmed by a published movie reference; exact licensed-English title remains unestablished.

rows.en: Y-yes.
rows.notes: Both s03s10:306 and :485 read; hesitant assent works in both.

rows.en: Apparently, the Hisago Plan's accident investigation committee decided that was a mistaken sighting.
That's just... the committee not wanting to do its job.
Investigating the facts is part of our mission too. But rescuing Dendoh comes first... Everyone, prepare for launch.
rows.notes: Ruri orders departure preparation; request direction retained.

rows.en: So these are Dendoh's pilots...
I-it's huge...!
rows.notes: Spiral Castle is the referent; neutral it used.

rows.en: So this is the enemy we're fighting... Gulfer...
I knew humans were small creatures, but...
These ones are especially small, even among humans.
Damn it...! They just keep running their mouths...!
Stop it, Ginga...! We can't make any rash moves here.
You captured Dendoh and its pilots... Impressive as ever, Altair.
rows.notes: Root convention review: dropped source honorific per brief; no fixed Lord title in glossary.

rows.en: So that's Ogre's pilot...
rows.notes: Short unit name Ogre follows do-not-touch mapping.

rows.en: He looks human, just like us...
rows.notes: Removed stray source closing wrapper and trailing break; Altair male per glossary.

rows.en: ...I don't know why, but Dendoh seems to have parted with its two Data Weapons.
I intend to capture them. They should have followed their masters here to the Moon.
rows.notes: Data Weapons follow their masters, the captive pilots, to the Moon.

rows.en: Then what do you intend to do with these humans?
I'll send them to His Majesty the Emperor. Even wretches like these are pilots chosen by Dendoh, after all.
Did he just call us wretches...?!
rows.notes: Echoes the contempt in 464.

rows.en: Don't provoke them, Ginga.
Will these humans eventually serve under you, Altair?
rows.notes: Root convention review: dropped source honorific per brief; no fixed Lord title in glossary.

rows.en: Or they'll serve under Subaru...
rows.notes: Restored serve-under predicate from 467.

rows.en: Subaru...?
Their allies will probably come here to take them back.
Spiral Castle... I'll leave them in your custody until I capture the Data Weapons.
As you command...
W-we...
rows.notes: Deliberate cross-row fragment continues conceptually in Hokuto 474.

rows.en: What's going to happen to us...?
rows.notes: Restored us from Ginga 473.

rows.en: You bastards locked us up in here! Let us out! Let us out, damn it!!
Shut up, brat! Keep quiet, or I'll make you suffer!
Let him be. They can't get out of here anyway. Let him scream all he wants.
You've got a point.
rows.notes: Removed stray closing wrapper and trailing break.

rows.en: Listen, brat. We'll keep a close watch on you. Trying to escape won't do you any good, right?
rows.notes: Meaning correction: restored the rhetorical question ending.

rows.en: See ya! Gwahahahaha!
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper and @ indentation ignored.

rows.en: Daaaamn it! Let us out! Let us out of here!!
rows.notes: Meaning review removed unsupported insult noun; emphatic rough imperative remains.

rows.en: Shouting won't help, Ginga. If they'd let us out just because we asked, they wouldn't have locked us up in the first place.
That doesn't mean I can just sit quietly like you!
...Let's wait for a chance, whether we're going to break out of here or wait for help.
rows.notes: Hokuto proposes waiting for an opportunity for escape or rescue.

rows.en: B-but... I saw them when they brought us here...
There are so many Machine Beasts in Spiral Castle, it's not even funny!
Yeah...
Who's there!?
Hokuto, Ginga... Are you all right?
rows.notes: Vega's identity is inferable, but prefilled hidden label ??? preserved.

rows.en: V-Vega!?
Thank goodness... You both seem to be safe.
W-what are you doing here!?
Never mind that. We need to escape, quickly. If we dawdle, they'll send you to the Gulfer homeworld along with Dendoh.
B-but, Vega, how did you get into Spiral Castle?
Don't tell me you rode your bike all the way here...?
Even I couldn't do that. When Ogre carried you away, I slipped inside Dendoh's maintenance hatch.
rows.notes: Vega stowed away through Dendoh's maintenance hatch when Ogre abducted the boys.

rows.en: Then what did you do about the guards outside our room?
I used a little magic trick to get them to move aside.
rows.notes: Magic trick is the euphemism Vega explains using her mask's voice imitation in 503-506.

rows.en: A magic trick...?
Here we are, at the hangar where Dendoh is. Let's escape, quickly.
But Dendoh's energy is already all gone...
It's all right. I ordered those guards to install Ogre's batteries in Dendoh earlier.
rows.notes: Vega ordered the guards to equip Dendoh with batteries intended for Ogre. Dendoh is the context-settled installation target. Meaning review explicitly restores Dendoh as installation target; batteries were intended for Ogre.

rows.en: You ordered them... How?
Like this.
Hmph. So this is the other GEAR... Dendoh.
rows.notes: Vega imitates Altair with the mask; original speaker Vega retained.

rows.en: Whoa! Th-that's his voice!
Your mask can even do that...?
Look out!!
Oh? You dodged my first stroke.
It's that guy from before!
It's Altair, Ogre's pilot!
So this is Altair...!
Those machines are huge and utterly useless. To let these children and a lone woman escape...
rows.notes: Altair insults the mechanical guards; deliberate trailing clause retained.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga. Leave this to me and get to Dendoh.
rows.notes: Vega takes on Altair so the boys can reach Dendoh.

rows.en: But what about you, Vega!?
I'll come after you, I promise. Hurry!
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper and @ indentation ignored. Meaning review preserves the later arrival promise without adding right-behind immediacy.

rows.en: You would sacrifice yourself? In honor of that noble spirit, I shall cut you down with a single stroke!
Ghh!!
You blocked my sword...! Impressive!
Vega!!
Hurry! I'll be all right!
Let's go, Hokuto! We'll wreak havoc from inside with Dendoh!
Y-yeah!
You won't escape!
I'm your opponent, Altair!
I don't know who you are, but you can regret the folly of standing before my sword in the afterlife!
Ghhh!
I've got you, woman!
Oh no, my mask!
Y-you're...!?

rows.notes: Nonverbal exclamation retained exactly as ASCII punctuation.

rows.en: Ugh! Uwaaaaaah!!
He started suffering when he saw me...!?
rows.notes: Thought: Altair's distress starts at seeing Vega unmasked; subject restored without guessing his motive.

rows.en: G-ghhhh! Y-you...!
If I'm going to escape, it has to be now!
rows.notes: Thought: Vega seizes his distress as an escape opportunity.

rows.en: Descent into the lunar exclusion zone complete! Distance to Spiral Castle: 23000!
rows.notes: Source gives 23000 without units; no metres or kilometres invented.

rows.en: Gulfer Machine Beasts detected! They're heading this way!
Shall we launch all units, Captain!?
No. Fire a wide-area Gravity Blast. Target the center of the enemy formation.
rows.notes: Broad-area blast centered on the enemy formation, not a beam-supply command.

rows.en: Roger! Firing Gravity Blast!
Enemy first wave annihilated!
A-amazing...! With this, we can...!
rows.notes: Eris trails off at their new prospect of success.

rows.en: This is only the beginning. Omoikane, maximum combat speed.
Distance to Spiral Castle: 19000!
rows.notes: Source gives 19000 without units; no units invented.

rows.en: Fire Gravity Blast at maximum output as soon as we're in range. We'll open a way through.
Captain, I... I really do want to...!
rows.notes: Eris volunteers to leave; source trails off and Ruri grants permission next.

rows.en: Yes, be careful. But our objective is to rescue Dendoh... not destroy Spiral Castle. You understand?
rows.notes: Ruri permits Eris to go but warns her the objective is rescue, not castle destruction.

rows.en: Yes, I understand! All right, I'm off!
W-will she... be all right?
rows.notes: Hari refers to Eris, whose glossary sources establish gender.

rows.en: There's no need to worry. Everyone seems far more accustomed to this than I expected.
rows.notes: Everyone refers to the experienced rescuers; no claim that Hari himself is experienced.

rows.en: Then it's up to us now, isn't it?
That's right.
Th-this is... a call from Vega!?
She's GEAR's deputy commander, right? Thank goodness she's safe...!
rows.notes: GEAR here is the organization, unlike the robot class at 504.

rows.en: Y-yes...!
Put the transmission on the main channel.
Yes!
...This is... Vega...
Vega, what's your situation!?
...We're... in Dendoh... time to escape... buy us...
rows.notes: Broken radio transmission retained; next Ruri order confirms Vega asks the allies to buy escape time.
uncertain: Broken transmission: buy us time reconstructed from the heard fragments and Ruri's following rescue orders; gaps remain explicit.

rows.en: Escape!? You can escape!?
Vega, please respond! Vega!!
...Harry, we're changing the plan. As soon as we enter the area around Spiral Castle, all units are to launch immediately.
rows.notes: Plan change follows interrupted escape transmission; launches all units immediately upon entering surrounding area. Spoken Harry is sourced nickname; prefilled speaker untouched.

rows.en: Have them buy us time until Dendoh escapes.
rows.notes: Hari is to have pilots buy escape time.

rows.en: You won't escape, Dendoh!!
If you think we'll let you capture us twice...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished conditional continues into Ginga forceful refusal; no complete claim of repeated capture.

rows.en: Like hell we will!!
rows.notes: Forceful denial completes preceding interrupted construction.

rows.en: Do you really think you can defeat my Ogre...?
Baikanfu will never lose to an evil heart controlled by darkness!
rows.notes: Rom explicitly makes Baikanfu the undefeated subject.

rows.en: I'll pay you back for last time!!
Stay out of my way!!
Behave yourselves, you brats! You can't escape anyway!
Shut up! Once Leo and Unicorn come back, we won't need to run!
rows.notes: Source-short Leo and Unicorn retained for Data Weapons Leo Circle and Unicorn Drill.

rows.en: No, Ginga! Our mission is to return to the mothership!
Oh, right! I forgot! But let's beat this old hag first!
rows.notes: Old-hag insult retains age-based mockery.

rows.en: Old hag?! You really are a bunch of obnoxious brats!
Anyone who aids evil is evil too! I'll take you on!
Are all martial artists such sweaty, overbearing men, no matter what planet they're from...?
rows.notes: Diondra stereotypes martial artists as hot, overbearing; scope covers every planet.

rows.en: Fine, then! I'll finish you and Rom off together!
Well, well... You're a bit past your prime, but you're quite a looker...
rows.notes: Saburota flirts while referring to Diondra being past her prime.

rows.en: W-what are you?! What are you talking about?!
Too bad! I'm out of time today, so we'll have to make that date some other time!
There you are, you aging machine hag!
rows.notes: Mechanical life-form female and age insult preserved; machine hag conveys derogatory register.

rows.en: Shut up, you little girl!!
Hey, hey, #女愛称... Whether she's past her prime doesn't have anything to do with the battle, does it...?
rows.notes: Female nickname placeholder exact; male lead questions relevance of age insult.

rows.en: Kirakuni, be careful! That mechanical life-form uses some strange attacks!
I know that, but when my opponent looks like a woman, I find it hard to attack her...
rows.notes: Opponent female appearance is explicit, referring to Diondra; trailing excuse retained.

rows.en: Oh, come on! This is no time to be saying things like that!!
Hold it, kid! We ain't lettin' you escape! Our Commander Ranking depends on it!
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 collective we; Commander Ranking exact campaign convention. Regional informal diction establishes joke.

rows.en: That ain't our problem!
rows.notes: Ginga imitates preceding regional diction rather than changing character background.

rows.en: Wow, Ginga! You can speak in Kansai dialect!
rows.notes: Kansai dialect explicitly named; English diction is an approximation, not a claim of English-region origin.
uncertain: Kansai-dialect joke uses informal English diction as an approximation; exact regional flavor cannot be reproduced.

rows.en: Heh heh... I guess I picked it up listening to their comedy routines.
rows.notes: Manzai rendered comedy routines, the source cause of dialect imitation.

rows.en: You little punk! Even we're pissed off after being made fools of like this!
rows.notes: Insult and anger kept forceful.

rows.en: Oh, no! Now that I look at him... He's a martial artist from Earth!
We ain't got any good memories of martial artists!
All the better! My fists will give you fresh memories of defeat!
rows.notes: Fists will give new memories of defeat; callback to previous bad martial-artist experiences.

rows.en: Don't go meddlin', Rom Stol!
rows.notes: Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: You ain't got anything to do with the people on this planet!
Where there is evil, there is justice! With Kenro to guide me, I'll punish you!
rows.notes: Kenro sourced sword name; Rom performs punishment.

rows.en: So you came all the way to the Moon to recover Dendoh...! But that will prove fatal!
Not if I can help it! Ginga and Hokuto are safe. We're getting them out of here!
Oh... You're the man who failed to protect Dendoh on Earth...
Did you come all the way to the Moon because you feel responsible?
rows.notes: Responsibility for earlier failure motivates Moon journey in Altair question.

rows.en: Yes, that's right! Ginga and Hokuto are our friends...
I've had enough of losing friends right in front of my eyes!
rows.notes: Loss of comrades allusion retained without narrowing loss into explicit death or naming a past event.

rows.en: #男愛称...
rows.notes: Female lead addresses male lead by runtime nickname; vocative fragment.

rows.en: We've entered the area around Spiral Castle!
Then... All units, launch.
rows.notes: Formal sortie imperative retained.

rows.en: S-so that's Spiral Castle!
I-it looks like a huge Funnel...!
rows.notes: Funnel is sourced Gundam weapon term, capitalized after meaning review.

rows.en: Now that you mention it, it really does...
W-we have to fight something like that...!
rows.notes: Fearful unfinished exclamation with we restored.

rows.en: It's not like it's going to move and attack us. Don't be so scared.
Everyone, the changes to the plan are just as I explained earlier...
rows.notes: Unfinished explanation introduces following instruction.

rows.en: Keep the Gulfer Machine Beasts occupied until Dendoh escapes from Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: Allied pilots draw Gulfer Machine Beasts until Dendoh escape.

rows.en: But whatever you do, don't chase them too far.
I know, I know. I'm not planning to take that thing head-on with the forces we've got.
Captain Takasugi, don't forget to keep Dendoh's escape route clear, all right?
rows.notes: Game Captain rank follows glossary discrepancy note; title addresses Saburota.

rows.en: Roger, roger. Well, let's go rescue our captive princess... I mean, princes!
rows.notes: Princess-to-princes joke applies to two captive boys.

rows.en: Yes!
Oh, and one more thing...
rows.notes: Unfinished addendum retained.

rows.en: You're going to tell us to stay close to the Nadesico so we can escape too, right?
Now, I wonder if the gentleman over there got that message too...
rows.notes: Gentleman is Domon, established by following line.

rows.en: Hold on, Hokuto, Ginga. I'll get you both out of there, I promise...!
That takes me back. ...Well, I guess he'll be all right.
rows.notes: Familiar martial-artist enthusiasm; no invented backstory for reminiscence.

rows.en: #男愛称, you understand, right?
Yeah. I'm never going through that again...!
rows.notes: Past experience allusion retains ambiguity, no invented named incident.

rows.en: Going through... what?
rows.notes: Actual thought echoes allusion; unfinished query retained.

rows.en: All right! Let's go, everyone!
...Now that we have captured Dendoh... the mission His Majesty the Emperor entrusted to me... is nearing completion...
rows.notes: Emperor entrusted mission is nearing completion, not completed.

rows.en: I won't let you interfere, humans... Let your blood stain this white land red...
rows.notes: Blood staining white Moon ground retained at original violence.

rows.en: Oyakata-sama, it seems Dendoh's pilots have escaped from their cage.
rows.notes: Known two captive pilots supplies plural. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: What was he doing?
rows.notes: He is Altair, confirmed by subsequent thought.

rows.en: Well... It seems he let them slip right through his fingers.
rows.notes: Altair let pilots get away; no reversed escape/capture direction.

rows.en: Have the Machine Beasts pursue them. You may use the Gyandlar troops as well.
Yes.
rows.notes: Bare formal acknowledgment preserved; no added title.

rows.en: Damn that Altair... At a time like this...!
rows.notes: Actual thought retains curse and incomplete time clause.

rows.en: ...These readings... Omoikane, check the data Eris gave us.
rows.notes: Sensor readings prompt verification of data Eris supplied.

rows.en: Captain, what's wrong?
...They seem quite devoted to their masters.
rows.notes: Data Weapons are devoted to bonded pilots; identified by next reply.

rows.en: Their masters? Do you mean the Data Weapons are...?
rows.notes: Unfinished Data Weapon hypothesis retained.

rows.en: Everyone, Dendoh will be coming out soon.
Is that really true?!
It is. Dendoh will emerge in sixty seconds, give or take a little.
rows.notes: Answers Roux at numeric use 506; sixty-second prediction retained. Restored Dendoh emergence subject/action from numeric use 505.

rows.en: Have you got anything to back that up?
Yeah, don't worry about that. Our captain's insight runs deeper than the sea.
rows.notes: Sea-depth metaphor retained.

rows.en: Well then, let's get their grand exit ready.
rows.notes: Grand exit means clearing the rescuees escape path.

rows.en: Everyone, please stay close to the Nadesico at all times. Otherwise, we'll be in serious trouble.
rows.notes: Departure warning addressed to all pilots.

rows.en: So we should approach Spiral Castle in a tight formation, right?
Yes. Otherwise, we won't all be able to get home.
Oyakata-sama, Dendoh is...!
rows.notes: Alert deliberately trails off. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Hmm...!
All right! We're outside!!
Ginga, look over there!!
E-everyone...!
rows.notes: Recognition interjection retained.

rows.en: Ginga! Hokuto! Are you all right?!
Y-yeah! We're fine, Domon!
Good. Now we just need to open a way out for them...
rows.notes: Unfinished plan to create an escape route retained.

rows.en: Enemy contacts inside Spiral Castle! They're coming after them!!
rows.notes: Enemy contacts are pursuers of Dendoh, not of Hari.

rows.en: Well, that's only to be expected.
Aaah!!
They've surrounded us!
Did ya think we'd let ya run off that easy, ya damn idiot?!
Shut up! Whoever calls someone an idiot is the real idiot!!
Hey! Ya got the accent wrong! It's ee-diot! Ee-diot!
rows.notes: Dialect accent joke adapted as ee-diot, keeping repeated correction.
uncertain: Accent gag adapted with ee-diot; Japanese vowel accent cannot be reproduced exactly.

rows.en: Who cares how you say it?!
Honestly, what noisy little brats. You're not getting away, you know?
You moron! Our friends have already come to pick us up!
Pick ya up...? Don't tell me ya mean him?!
N-no, no way. Speak of the devil, and up pops a cliff... er, his shadow.
rows.notes: Japanese proverb slips from shadow to cliff; cliff gag retained via English speak-of-the-devil wording.
uncertain: Cliff/shadow proverb slip adapted to English speak-of-the-devil wording; exact Japanese wordplay is unavoidably changed.

rows.en: Anyway, someone's come to pick ya up, all right... straight from hell!
rows.notes: Pickup becomes a threatening ride from hell.

rows.en: Not even an ant could slip through this blockade! How're ya gonna get out?!
I'll smash my way through with my fists!!
Ooh, ooh, look at ya go. Ah, so cool. So very cool.
rows.notes: Sarcastic praise retained.

rows.en: But will ya still be sayin' that when he shows up?!
rows.notes: He here means incoming Altair; earlier him at 665 reflects feared Rom.

rows.en: He?!
There, look! Your ride from hell's here!
You won't escape, Dendoh...!
Ogre... Altair!!
rows.notes: Ogre short unit name follows locked glossary.

rows.en: H-hey! Aren't we in trouble here?!
W-with him in that position, we can't even fire the Gravity Blast...!!
rows.notes: Altair position prevents friendly Gravity Blast use.

rows.en: Gahahahaha! Serves ya right, ya little shit!!
D-damn it...!!
If only Unicorn and Leo were here now...!
rows.notes: Source short Data Weapon names Unicorn and Leo retained.

rows.en: Ginga! Hokuto!!
That settles it, then...
Yes. They gave us some trouble, but...
rows.notes: Trailing concession retained.

rows.en: Give up... Like hell I'm giving up!!
That's right...! If we give up, it's all over!
Hokuto, Ginga...! How can I be so helpless when you need me most...?!
I won't make the same mistake again! Let's go, #男愛称!
rows.notes: Domon refuses to repeat a past failure; no unspoken incident added.

rows.en: Yeah! #女愛称, I'm counting on you to adjust the output!
rows.notes: Request goes from male lead to female lead; output adjustment action explicit.

rows.en: Right! Leave it to me!!
Really, this takes me back... Well, while we're getting into the spirit of things, I'll join in too.
rows.notes: Saburota recalls old rescue theatrics and joins the charge.

rows.en: C-Captain, what should we do?!
We'll be all right.
What?!
All of you, finish off everyone except Dendoh.
rows.notes: Dendoh alone is excluded from the kill order.

rows.en: Ya don't have to tell me twice!
Now, prepare yourselves!
Hold it!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? despite subsequent Rom identification.
Retained source punctuation-only surprise without added spoken What.

rows.en: W-what the hell?! Who's that?!
Where? Where are you? Show yourself! Who are you?!
Is that...?!
You fools who know nothing of the futility of battle... Fighting is only justified when it saves those you love.
rows.notes: Rom rhetorical speech retains elevated register.

rows.en: Those who have the courage to sacrifice their lives for that victory... People call them heroes!
rows.notes: Sacrifice courage and hero definition retained.

rows.en: What...? You dare do as you please here in Spiral Castle? Who are you?!
I have no name to give the likes of you!!
rows.notes: Rom signature refusal to name himself retained.

rows.en: Where there is darkness, there is light... Where there is evil, there is justice.
rows.notes: Paired light/justice maxim preserved.

rows.en: Kenryuu, envoy of the heavens, has arrived!
rows.notes: Kenryuu envoy-of-heavens self-introduction.

rows.en: Damn you, Rom Stol! You sniffed this place out, did you?!
I had a feelin' this was gonna happen...
Damn you! You never learn! Then I have no choice! Viper Drive, install!
rows.notes: Viper Drive follows campaign term; independent canonical English provenance unestablished.
uncertain: Viper Drive supplied campaign mapping is source-literal; independent canonical English provenance unestablished.

rows.en: Then I'll do the same!
Piiile Formaaation!!
rows.notes: Pile Formation elongated activation shout retained.

rows.en: Baikanfu has arrived!!
rows.notes: Baikanfu appearance call rendered in English.

rows.en: Hey, wait! Pullin' that out without warnin' ain't fair!
Unfair? Devil Saturn 6, those words suit you better than anyone!
H-he's so cool...!
rows.notes: Restored Rom subject and copula; stutter retained.

rows.en: Harry?
Oh... s-sorry. But what you said earlier, Captain...
rows.notes: Hesitant unfinished question about Ruri prediction retained.

rows.en: It wasn't what I predicted... Well, never mind.
rows.notes: Ruri admits arrival differed from her forecast.

rows.en: By the way, he's on our side, isn't he?
rows.notes: Rom referent male per sourced character glossary.

rows.en: Y-yes... He helped us during Operation Yashima, too.
rows.notes: He refers to Rom, whom Ruri asks about in 719; Rain cites Operation Yashima.
Rom's silence; later silence before thanks also checked.

rows.en: Th-that guy from before...!
You came to rescue us...!?
rows.notes: Hokuto addresses Rom directly.

rows.en: ...Call them.
rows.notes: Call them means summon the boys' Data Weapons; restored the object from 724 and 730.

rows.en: Huh!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: The sacred electronic beasts are already nearby.
rows.notes: Uses campaign_terms poetic epithet rather than substituting a unit name. Meaning review clarifies the beasts are nearby, as the following appearance shows; no compression.
Leo Circle remains silent across repeated appearances.

rows.en: L-Leo!!
Unicorn...! Did you follow us here...?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks whether Unicorn followed the boys; source question trails off.

rows.en: There they are! Perfect, I'll get them all at once...!
rows.notes: Altair spots both Data Weapons and threatens them; cutoff retained.

rows.en: I won't let you!!
Ghh, you!!
Now, call them! Call your sacred beasts!!
Hokuto!!
Ginga!!
File Save, Leo Circle!!
File Save, Unicorn Drill!!
Unicorn!!
Leo, welcome back!!
I'm so glad... I really am...!
rows.notes: Meaning/register review restores Eris's spoken relief rather than a formal Truly; no compression.

rows.en: Well now, I feel like that guy's stolen all the glory...
rows.notes: Saburota jokes that Rom took all the glory.

rows.en: Captain, isn't it about time we called it a day?
Yes. I'm terribly sorry to interrupt when things are getting so exciting, but...
rows.notes: Ruri apologetically interrupts the celebratory scene; sentence continues into 741.

rows.en: Everyone, please return to the Nadesico within three minutes from now.
Roger!
rows.notes: Prefilled runtime nickname speaker preserved verbatim.

rows.en: Once you've all returned, we'll leave this sector at full speed.
What about that guy!?
Don't worry about me... You must escape from here.
B-but!
Hurry! You haven't got time to spare, have you!?
I'm sorry... Please make it within three minutes.
rows.notes: Ruri asks the team to meet her deadline; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Do not let them escape... Pursue them...!
You needn't tell me! You won't escape, humans!
1. Load allied units onto Nadesico B in time
rows.notes: Plain victory objective; source has zero @. Measured compression: original plain segment 385 px exceeds 352; tightens deadline to in time while preserving action, allied units and Nadesico B.

rows.en: 1. Failure to load allied units other than Rom@   aboard Nadesico B before time runs out@2. Any allied unit shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat conditions; keeps two @ and explicit Rom exception.

rows.en: Everyone, you have two minutes left. Please hurry back to the Nadesico.
Everyone, you have one minute left. In other words, you must return to the Nadesico before this turn ends.
rows.notes: One-minute warning equates to end of current turn; neither condition omitted.

rows.en: U-ughhh!?
Altair!?
W-what is this...!? This headache!!
rows.notes: Altair's headache is unexplained; no motive added.

rows.en: Damn it! You'll pay for this!!
rows.notes: Hostile defeat threat preserved.

rows.en: Th-this whole thing's a right mess!!
rows.notes: Kansai comic idiom rendered as a right mess; no new insult added.

rows.en: All right, Omoikane... Withdraw at full speed.
Thanks, mister...!
There's no need to thank me. We'll meet again.
Phew... We finally made it back...
Man... I've had enough...
But I'm so glad... All three of you are safe.
rows.notes: The three rescued people are Ginga, Hokuto and Vega.

rows.en: When I heard you'd been taken to Spiral Castle, I didn't know what would happen to you...
You two did well to keep going without giving up.
No, it's thanks to everyone and Vega.
And... that man called Rom Stol, too.
rows.notes: Prefilled male lead runtime nickname speaker preserved; body identifies Rom Stol.

rows.en: That's right... Just who is he?
He's the successor to a martial art called Tenku Chushin Ken, from a planet called Cronos. I know little else about him, but...
rows.notes: Domon introduces martial art and planet; final but continues into 771.

rows.en: I can tell he's highly skilled.
Ohhh... The King of Hearts himself gives him his seal of approval, huh?
And he seems to know about the Data Weapons, too...
Since he's from another planet, perhaps he saw them somewhere... or heard rumors about them?
I wonder if he'd join us.
Then maybe we could find the Data Weapons without relying on Eris's program.
rows.notes: Ginga's dismissive dig at Eris's program provokes her apology; not softened.

rows.en: W-well, Ginga, Unicorn and Leo are back now. Can't we just say all's well that ends well?

rows.notes: Silence shared by s0270:254 and i027a:34; fits both shame and withdrawal after the later mission discussion.

rows.en: E-Eris...!
...I'm sorry, Ginga, Hokuto...
Huh...?
rows.notes: Reaction only.

rows.en: My tracking program made Unicorn and Leo run away... and that put you both in danger...
rows.notes: Eris says her tracker made the Data Weapons flee and endangered the boys; unfinished cadence preserved.

rows.en: That's right! We went through hell because of you!
...I'm sorry...
Ginga, Eris didn't mean any harm. Please understand that much, at least.
That's right. Be a man and forgive her with a smile.
rows.notes: Roux invokes being a man as her reason for forgiving; source gendered admonition kept.

rows.en: But we were this close to being sent to the Gulfer homeworld!
Eris worked really hard to help rescue you, too, you know?
rows.notes: Ple credits Eris's rescue efforts; you refers to Ginga and the rescued group.

rows.en: We let our guard down, too, and that's why Ogre captured us...
rows.notes: Hokuto admits the boys were careless too; unfinished linking clause retained.

rows.en: It's not right to blame Eris alone.
All right! All right, I get it!
Eris, you're really sorry about what you did, right?
Y-yeah...
Then finish that tracking program and find the remaining Data Weapons for us.
rows.notes: Ginga requests Eris to complete tracker and find remaining Data Weapons, not the other way around.

rows.en: You'll... forgive me?
What's there to forgive? If people yelled at me every time I messed up, I'd be getting chewed out all day, every day.
rows.notes: Ginga forgives by comparing his own frequent mistakes; no actual daily punishment asserted.

rows.en: You're one of us, too... If you keep looking so miserable, we won't know what to do.
rows.notes: You're one of us explicitly preserves her membership in the group.

rows.en: Thank you, Ginga...
W-what...? You don't have to thank me...!
Good grief... You just can't be honest about your feelings.
rows.notes: Hokuto teases Ginga's inability to express caring straightforwardly.

rows.en: Ah, youth.
rows.notes: Saburota comments on the children's budding affection; compact source remark retained.

rows.en: You can say that again.
Lieutenant Commander Hoshino, thank you for coming all the way to the Moon to rescue us.
rows.notes: Vega thanks Ruri for the trip to rescue them; naval Lieutenant Commander follows sourced profile.

rows.en: Not at all. I'm just glad you're safe. And I'm sorry to ask so soon, but...
rows.notes: Ruri replies to thanks then trails into early data request.

rows.en: Could you provide the data you gathered inside Spiral Castle? We'd like to analyze it too.
rows.notes: Request goes from Ruri to Vega; data obtained inside Spiral Castle, to be analyzed on their side too.

rows.en: Of course.
Captain, what are we going to do now?
We'll return to our mission of investigating the incidents involving the Hisago Plan.
rows.notes: Returns to investigation duty for Hisago Plan incidents, not beginning unrelated assignment.

rows.en: Do you mean the black ghost robot?
rows.notes: Black ghost robot remains descriptive; identity not supplied.

rows.en: That's part of it... But there's a lot more. I'm sorry to impose, but could we ask for your help?
rows.notes: Ruri asks Vega for cooperation; not an offer to help Vega.

rows.en: Yes, of course.
Meio... You have done well in persuading the young officers.
rows.notes: Marshal thanks Meio for persuading younger officers.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
rows.notes: Stray closing Japanese quote/trailing @ indentation ignored as brief directs.

rows.en: Had you not returned to the Moon, they might have rebelled against the high command...
rows.notes: Counterfactual: without Meio returning to Moon, junior officers might have revolted.

rows.en: You did well to keep the situation from deteriorating. You have my thanks.
Not at all, sir. They are men who would gladly lay down their lives for their country...
rows.notes: Willingness to give lives for country retained; trailing description stays reflective.

rows.en: They have put aside their doubts about the high command and pledged to work toward realizing your ideals once more, Marshal.
rows.notes: Junior officers put aside doubts and renew commitment to realizing Guiltorre ideals.

rows.en: I see...
However, it is also true that some members of the high command are at fault...
rows.notes: Meio acknowledges some high-command members are actually at fault.

rows.en: Unless we resolve the root of the problem, I believe the same thing will happen again.
What are you trying to say?
I mean Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov. Why do you permit his tyranny, Marshal?
rows.notes: Dorchenov tyranny is issue; source Lieutenant Colonel rank from sourced profile.

rows.en: That man harbors dark, sinister intentions.
rows.notes: Dark inner intentions rendered as sinister designs, not physical stomach description.

rows.en: There are also rumors... No, evidence that he has been secretly contacting remnants of the Jovian Federation.
rows.notes: Corrects rumors into evidence; secret contact concerns Jovian Federation remnants.

rows.en: If Lieutenant Colonel Dorchenov is left unchecked, he will surely become a threat to Giganos.
Meio, you must understand as well...
rows.notes: Marshal appeals to Meio understanding; trailing ending kept.

rows.en: To end the Earth Federation's evil rule and establish a new order in the Earth Sphere, we need men such as him too.
rows.notes: Federation evil rule, Earth Sphere new order, and necessity of such men all retained.

rows.en: Are you saying I must be broad-minded enough to accept both good and evil?
rows.notes: Good-and-evil tolerance idiom rendered explicitly as broad-minded acceptance.

rows.en: Yes. Just as Zeon once did, we must use force to bring down the corrupt Federation system.
rows.notes: Source-short Zeon centrally verified by root via Akurasu Pilot Database; force needed to break corrupt regime.

rows.en: That is why I brought down the hammer of the Mass Driver...
rows.notes: Mass Driver as hammer metaphor retained, along with Guiltorre responsibility.

rows.en: The Earth Sphere is now beyond saving through reforms that take their natural course.

rows.notes: Intentional silence. Meio silent under orders; silence deliberately retained.

rows.en: Like Gihren Zabi, I will go down in history as a man who chose to commit humanity's greatest folly...
rows.notes: Gihren Zabi centrally verified by root via Akurasu Seiyuu List; greatest human folly and historical judgment retained.

rows.en: But it is all for the sake of building a new order and giving humanity a new beginning.
I believe I understand your thinking, Marshal.
But so long as there are men who do not recognize folly as folly, our Giganos Empire...
rows.notes: Unfinished Giganos Empire warning cut off by Dorchenov arrival; no inferred outcome added.

rows.en: Marshal!
Dorchenov...!
rows.notes: Actual thought-name exclamation retained.

rows.en: What is it, Lieutenant Colonel?
Marshal, what is the meaning of letting those young officers go without any reprimand?
rows.notes: Dorchenov demands explanation for absence of any reprimand.

rows.en: For the sake of Giganos's iron unity, I urge you to punish them severely!
rows.notes: Dorchenov urges Marshal to punish officers; request direction explicit.

rows.en: There is no need. They have not actually taken any action to rebel.
rows.notes: Marshal says no actual rebellion action occurred, not that officers lack rebellious beliefs.

rows.en: You're soft. Far too soft. Like the current Earth Federation government, you'll only encourage them to grow more arrogant.
rows.notes: Condemnation of leniency and Federation-government comparison retained.

rows.en: I ask you to reconsider, if only to set an example for the others.
rows.notes: Dorchenov requests reconsideration to make an example.

rows.en: With respect, Lieutenant Colonel, they have sworn even greater loyalty to Marshal Guiltorre in my presence.
rows.notes: Meio respectfully rebuts Dorchenov; witnessed renewed loyalty to Guiltorre.

rows.en: Therefore, I judge punishment unnecessary.
Hmph. You have no right to say that to me.
Because your father, Lang Plato, handed the D-Weapons to the Federation Forces...
rows.notes: Causal fragment accusing father Lang Plato stays unfinished; source has no Doctor title.

rows.en: And because you failed to recapture them, they have now reached the stage of producing mass-produced models.
rows.notes: Recapture failure leads to enemies producing mass-produced models; source connection retained.

rows.en: How exactly do you intend to take responsibility for this?
I... intend to do so by defeating the enemies who threaten Giganos.
rows.notes: Meio says how he intends to take responsibility; subject and action explicit.

rows.en: Very well. In that case, I shall give you a new order at once.
Yes, sir...
We've learned a new mobile suit model is being developed on La Vie en Rose, the dock ship now used by the Federation Forces.
rows.notes: Only measured overflow compression. New mobile suit model developed aboard dock ship currently used by Federation; all content kept.

rows.en: Lead a Metal Armor unit into battle immediately and seize it along with La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: Order is to lead Metal Armor unit and seize both new mobile suit and dock ship.

rows.en: Understood. If you'll excuse me...
rows.notes: Polite departure cutoff retained.

rows.en: ...Marshal, there is still something I wish to say.
Is it about the Mass Driver?
Yes. Once the Federation Forces get their mass-produced Dragonars into steady production...
rows.notes: Conditional production setup stays incomplete, continued by following counteroffensive prediction.

rows.en: I expect them to plan a counteroffensive against our Giganos forces.
rows.notes: Counteroffensive is anticipated against Giganos; restored explicit expect/they relationship.

rows.en: Before that happens, if you would use the Mass Driver to attack their mass-production factories and bases...
rows.notes: Dorchenov unfinished proposal requests Marshal use Mass Driver on factories and bases; final conditional preserves cutoff.

rows.en: No.
Why?! Are you telling me to stand by and let the Federation build up its strength?!
I have prepared other means of opposing the Federation besides the Mass Driver. Therefore, I will not permit it to be used again.
rows.notes: Marshal prepared alternatives to Mass Driver; refuses second use.
Silent shocked response retained.

rows.en: We are already past the point where he can afford to say such things...!
rows.notes: Actual thought objects that current situation no longer permits restraint; Marshal referent supplied.

rows.en: If it has come to this, I may have no choice but to resort to extreme measures...
rows.notes: Actual thought moves toward drastic measures; method remains undisclosed.
